entries.title: Your usage reporting connection reaches a tool your computer trusts, and says when it cannot
entries.body: A usage reporting connection you add in Settings → Intelligence now reaches a monitoring tool on your company's own network whenever your computer trusts it, as the reporting your company sets up already does. When a send does not get through, Settings → Usage says so right away and why: the tool could not be reached, it turned the send away, or Infinitary could not connect to it securely.

picture.alt: Settings → Usage warning that the crew's usage is not reaching the reporting connection, because Infinitary could not connect to it securely
